notes: The World map now shows the weather: drizzle, rain, downpours and thunderstorms (with lightning), falling snow that piles up on the districts and melts when it warms up, drifting fog, and a warm haze on hot days.

People react to it: in bad weather fewer people are out and the ones who are carry umbrellas, cats, dogs and birds take cover, and on hot days people head for the water. On New Year's Eve the streets fill up late.

Holidays are decorated on the map and behind the story: string lights from December 1 to the 26th, pumpkins and bats in the last week of October, floating hearts on Valentine's Day, fireworks on New Year's Eve night, and bunting and confetti for any other holiday (including ones you add yourself).
Snow piles up along the bottom of the story screen after a snowfall.
